  "markdown_report": "**Recommendation:** test recent-item-conditioned residual gates in corrected NextItNet. At 10% progress, retain this feasible hypothesis, but require comparison with the starting `[h,u]` gate before attributing benefits to item conditioning.

**Insights from the starting point.** (1) Zero gate weights preserve the ordinary residual computation `h+u`, not an identity block. This preserves initial forward behavior, not optimization trajectories. (2) Older and recent deletions generally worsen training rankings. Selective modulation merits testing, but suppressing an update neither removes older information from the skip nor demonstrates forgetting. (3) Electronics’ −0.0106 tenth-percentile training margin and 10.04% negative-over-positive rate indicate weak sampled separation. They do not identify an architectural cause or measure validation HR@10.

**Insights from related work.** (1) Highway Networks, WaveNet, GLUs and FiLM establish contextual gating/modulation [1–4]. Novelty rests on demonstrated value from direct current-item conditioning. (2) ReZero and LayerScale establish residual scaling as an optimization mechanism [5–6]. Neither supports interpreting gate values as retained intent. (3) Hard-BPR cautions against false negatives in mining [7]; modality dropout motivates missing-text robustness [8]. These remain separate alternatives.

The framework separates **context transformations**, **ranking supervision**, and **item evidence**. Gates modify transformations; robust negative training changes supervision; title encoders supply evidence. Direct `e_t` conditioning supplies easier access to existing information, not new observations.

Scores are originality/potential/user alignment/model alignment/difficulty, all 0–10; higher difficulty means harder. Each assessment includes a benefit and limitation.

| Idea | Originality | Potential | User alignment | Model alignment | Difficulty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Recent-item residual gates [1–4] | 3: specific conditioning; established mechanism | 6: controlled insight; possibly redundant | 7: recent specificity; needs unobserved | 6: contextual separation; indirect | 4: local edit; parity and controls |
| Robust hard-negative training [7] | 3: targeted application; established objective | 6: informative contrasts; false negatives | 5: distinguishes alternatives; intent unobserved | 8: weak separation; scale dependence | 5: standard scoring; sampling overhead |
| Joint title encoder with dropout [8] | 4: constrained adaptation; familiar fusion | 6: richer evidence; sparse supervision | 7: finer distinctions; compatibility uncertain | 5: richer features; benefit unverified | 6: simple pooling; metadata integration |

**Selected mechanism.** Extend `[h,u]` to `[h,u,e_t]`; initialize `W=0,b=2`, and apply `g=sigmoid(logit)/sigmoid(2)` to the completed residual update. Its range is `(0,1.1353)` and initial logit derivative is `0.1192`: suppression dominates amplification, with saturation risk. This targets broad similarity displacing recent mood/task matches and stale seasonal/ecosystem associations implying continuing demand. Ownership, compatibility and unmet need remain unobserved. Improved contextual separation could address Electronics’ margin failures; all benefits remain hypotheses.

Retain loss, dilations and protocol. Prioritize baseline, `[h,u]`, and `[h,u,e_t]`; additional constant-scale and capacity controls depend on budget. Verify export parity. Report gate saturation, original diagnostics, category hits, paired differences and discordant users. Use stratified paired bootstrap intervals and disclose every validation query [9–10]. Fixed-candidate HR@10 is exploratory sampled ranking, not full-catalog accuracy. No new performance is claimed.",
  "idea": {
    "description": "Add current-input-item-conditioned residual gates to the supplied corrected NextItNet. For each existing completed causal residual update u at position t, compute g_t = sigmoid(W[h_t; u_t; e_t] + b) / sigmoid(2), then return mask_t * (h_t + g_t * u_t). Here e_t is the current input item embedding, never its next-item prediction target. Initialize W=0 and b=2 to preserve the ordinary baseline residual computation h+u up to floating-point precision. Train every component jointly within exactly one network per category.",
    "motivation": "The proposal explicitly targets two user-facing failures: broad historical similarity displacing specific recent mood/task matches, and old seasonal or ecosystem associations being extended into continuing demand. Direct access to the current input embedding may make recent evidence easier to use after deeper transformations, although it introduces no information absent from the input sequence. Useful older context should remain available because deletion diagnostics generally worsen measured training rankings. Electronics’ 10.04% sampled negative-over-positive rate and −0.0106 tenth-percentile training margin motivate testing contextual discrimination. These observations neither establish that residual gating causes improvement nor identify historical forgetting as the required remedy. Ownership, compatibility, quantity appropriateness and unmet need remain unobserved; this method cannot claim to resolve those missing attributes.",
    "implementation_notes": "Architecture and mathematical interpretation: integrate the gate into each existing corrected residual block, preserving supplied convolutions, dilation schedule, channel-only normalization, dropout placement, padding masks and output transformations. Define u as exactly the completed update that the baseline would otherwise add to h, including its existing dropout; do not apply dropout twice. Pass the masked lookup output e_t from the same input item_emb through the stack as a position-local conditioning covariate. Do not detach it: its embedding parameters are jointly trained. Preserve any baseline embedding scaling and input dropout separately; do not silently substitute a differently transformed covariate across training and export. The gate introduces no additional temporal dependencies. It scales updates, not individual historical events, and h and u already contain sequence-derived information.

Initialize gate weights to zero and biases to two after any model-wide initializer. The initial forward block is h+u, rather than h, and baseline residual-branch gradients remain available. At initialization, the gate derivative with respect to its logit is 1−sigmoid(2), approximately 0.1192. Its input Jacobian through the gate projection is zero because W=0, while projection weights can receive gradients. Gate values lie in (0,1/sigmoid(2)), approximately (0,1.1353): amplification is limited to about 13.5%, whereas suppression can approach zero. Both sigmoid tails saturate. Identity initialization refers only to the initial multiplier being one; it does not guarantee matching training trajectories. Closing a gate leaves the skip h untouched, and neither that skip nor gate values guarantee information recoverability or historical forgetting after cancellation and downstream transformations. Do not change parameterization in the primary experiment; a nonsaturating scale would be a separate hypothesis.

Starting baseline and reproducibility: use the supplied corrected NextItNet implementation rather than inventing missing backbone or training details. Keep preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, at most 200 epochs and exactly 200 batches per epoch. Preserve Movies_and_TV, Industrial_and_Scientific, Electronics and CDs_and_Vinyl routing; DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR']; single-GPU execution; supplied splits; baseline optimizer, loss, negative sampling, validation schedule and checkpoint rule; and trial-local artifacts. Record the actual inherited hyperparameters, dilation pairs, gate covariate definition, gate dimensions, initialization order, optimizer parameter groups, configuration versions and actual completed updates. Give gate parameters the same declared optimizer treatment across gate variants. No execution or validation gain is asserted here.

Primary contrasts and budget: predeclare baseline h+u, the starting [h,u] gate and the proposed [h,u,e_t] gate as the priority comparison, with all four categories retained in every compared configuration. The [h,u,e_t] versus [h,u] contrast is necessary to attribute any observed increment to explicit item conditioning, though it still confounds conditioning with extra parameters. Prespecify configuration order, evaluation schedule, checkpoint/tie rules, stopping rules and GPU-second allocations within the remaining shared 43,200-second budget, including diagnostics, debugging and failures. If all primary contrasts cannot be afforded, prioritize [h,u] versus [h,u,e_t] and report the missing newly trained baseline comparison; supplied inspiration scores are historical context, not paired evidence. Initialize common baseline parameters identically using deterministic initialization ordering, and use separate seed-42-derived RNG streams for model initialization, family-specific batches, negative samples and training stochasticity where supported. Additional gate initialization must not accidentally shift shared baseline weights or batch sampling. Keep update counts and training opportunity comparable; disclose actual compute differences and incomplete runs. Compare configurations as alternatives and never fuse them. Do not load other trials’ checkpoints.

Secondary controls, only if predeclared and affordable: constant learned channel scales initialized to one distinguish adaptive modulation from residual scaling. Gate inputs h, u and [h,u] localize conditioning sources. A capacity control can replace e_t with a fixed projection of h into the same embedding dimension, retaining the same gate parameter count; this tests the added conditioning path without supplying direct item identity. A fixed training-item permutation used only for the gate covariate is an optional alignment control, but it preserves a consistent identity code and can be relearned, so it is not a decisive semantic control. Randomly shuffled covariates or frozen-checkpoint replacements additionally introduce distribution shift. Match initial residual scale and declare each control’s limitation. Do not claim that capacity or alignment has been isolated without the corresponding control. At this early stage, robust hard-negative training and jointly trained text encoding remain alternatives, not additions to the selected experiment.

Inference and serialization: keep item_emb, log2feats(sequence), predict_score(features, items), family-specific sample_batch and ModelView compatible. Read the maximum index with a nonzero item ID, never count−1, and retain the baseline empty-history behavior. Keep padding embedding row zero fixed and mask padded states wherever the baseline temporal operations require it. Record gate architecture, covariate semantics and configuration with each checkpoint; use identical definitions in the embedded predictor writer. Every category route loads exactly one independently trained selected model/checkpoint. Verify evaluation-mode feature and candidate-score parity after reconstruction for every route using identical histories, truncation, weights and candidates, including short left-padded histories. Existing diagnostics verified ModelView controls but did not verify exported-predictor parity. Restore training/evaluation mode after probes and never modify the official evaluator.

Diagnosis contract: retain DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis), returning measured metrics and metric_definitions. Preserve the (None, sequence, positive, negative) B x L loader contract, and keep view.model as the actual trained nn.Module. Retain original sampled-margin definitions, sampling and training-prefix sensitivity procedures. Add gate quantiles, projection-logit quantiles, fractions with sigmoid(logit)<0.01 or >0.99, and between-history variability stratified by position and history length; separately report counts and invalid/empty strata. Gates may exploit item frequency or identity shortcuts, so variability and current-item replacement sensitivity measure usage rather than desired semantics. Any supported frozen-model history perturbations must use matched candidate pools and retain the original interpretation: in-sample dependence, not user preference or generalization. Near-0.5 embedding alignment scores do not establish either collapse or diversity. Use explicit serializable architecture configuration for trial-local manifests rather than source inspection, which failed in the supplied diagnosis. Record routes, seeds, eligible prefixes, interventions, exclusions and checkpoint identifiers without relying on source availability.

Evaluation and uncertainty: selection uses only the fixed four-category macro validation HR@10 with 200 users/category and 99 unique negatives under evaluation seed 42. Do not change the evaluator, access hidden test data or interpret training margins as validation ranking. With host-provided paired hit indicators, report each category’s hit counts and HR@10, paired absolute differences and discordant wins/losses for both gates versus baseline and [h,u,e_t] versus [h,u]. Prespecify these contrasts. For 2,000 bootstrap replicates using a dedicated diagnostic seed 42, resample users within each category while retaining all compared models’ outcomes together, then equally average the four category differences. Report percentile 95% intervals; never reweight missing categories. If formal paired tests are desired and supported, apply exact McNemar tests within categories and predeclare Holm correction over the chosen family of tests; do not pool categories into an unexplained macro test. Tests and intervals condition on the fitted seed-42 models and pinned candidates, omit training-seed and candidate-resampling variability, and do not remove checkpoint/architecture selection bias. One changed hit moves category HR by 0.5 percentage points and macro HR by 0.125 percentage points. Log every attempted configuration, checkpoint-selection opportunity and validation query, including failures. Freeze the final procedure before the host’s held-out evaluation. Fixed sampled candidates support comparability but do not establish full-catalog ranking or robust architecture superiority.

Available evidence and user outcomes: use no unavailable reviews, ratings, categories, prices, stores or simulator traits. Only public histories, titles, descriptions and timestamps are permitted, and this first experiment needs no auxiliary metadata. Preserve native full-catalog unseen-item recommendations for the twenty training users, five/category. Where supported, track recent-specific acceptance reasons, broad-similarity rejections and unidentifiable items separately; do not manufacture compatibility or need labels. These qualitative observations complement, rather than replace, official macro validation HR@10.",
    "pseudocode": "import torch
from torch import nn

class RecentItemResidualGate(nn.Module):
    """B x L x D states; current item is an input, never the target."""
    def __init__(self, hidden_dim, item_dim=None, use_item=True):
        super().__init__()
        item_dim = hidden_dim if item_dim is None else item_dim
        self.use_item = use_item
        width = 2 * hidden_dim + (item_dim if use_item else 0)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(width, hidden_dim)
        self.reset_identity()

    def reset_identity(self):
        # Repeat after any model-wide initialization pass.
        nn.init.zeros_(self.proj.weight)
        nn.init.constant_(self.proj.bias, 2.0)

    def forward(self, h, completed_update, current_input_embedding, valid):
        mask = valid.to(device=h.device, dtype=h.dtype).unsqueeze(-1)
        parts = [h, completed_update]
        if self.use_item:
            parts.append(current_input_embedding * mask)
        logits = self.proj(torch.cat(parts, dim=-1))
        gate = torch.sigmoid(logits) / torch.sigmoid(logits.new_tensor(2.0))
        return (h + gate * completed_update) * mask

# Required integration into the supplied corrected baseline:

#     # u already contains precisely the baseline residual-path dropout.
#     if configuration == 'baseline':
#         h = (h + u) * valid.unsqueeze(-1)
#     else:
#         h = block.gate(h, u, e, valid)
# return existing_baseline_output_transform(h) * valid.unsqueeze(-1)
#
# These integration names denote existing host operations, not replacement
# backbone definitions. Copy their actual definitions unchanged.
#
# Before training:
#   predeclare affordable configurations, checkpoint rules and compute limits
#   initialize common baseline tensors identically with training seed 42
#   initialize gates last; assert initial output parity with baseline
#   retain the supplied loss, family-specific sampling and optimizer settings
# For each configuration and each of the four required categories:
#   train one model, epochs <= 200, exactly 200 batches per completed epoch
#   apply unchanged host validation/checkpoint selection
#   save one selected checkpoint plus explicit architecture configuration
#   write matching embedded predictor definitions and category routing
#   compare reconstructed features and scores in eval mode
#   verify causality, padding and final-nonpadding readout
# Report host validation hits, paired effects, costs and all attempted queries.
# Deploy exactly one selected model/checkpoint per category; never fuse outputs.",
    "originality": {
      "score": 3,
      "positive": "The direct current-item conditioning path is a concrete, testable adaptation of the starting NextItNet gate, with an explicit contrast against [h,u] conditioning.",
      "negative": "Highway Networks, WaveNet, GLUs and FiLM already establish gating and conditional feature scaling; e_t adds no new observed information, and its incremental contribution remains unverified."
    },
    "future_potential": {
      "score": 6,
      "positive": "Controlled comparisons can reveal whether direct access to current-item identity helps beyond residual scaling and existing contextual representations.",
      "negative": "The gate may become static, saturate or exploit item-frequency shortcuts; selected sampled-validation gains would not establish historical forgetting or robust generalization."
    },
    "code_difficulty": {
      "score": 4,
      "positive": "The architectural edit uses one position-local projection and sigmoid per existing block while retaining temporal convolutions and the training objective.",
      "negative": "Reproducible common initialization, fair conditioning controls, gate diagnostics, configuration serialization and category-specific predictor parity add meaningful experimental work."
    }
  },
